summary: On Ubuntu, use the ansible/ansible PPA for newer versions: install software-properties-common, add the PPA, and apt install ansible.
questions: How do I get a newer Ansible on Ubuntu?
How do I add the Ansible PPA?

answer_card.title: Install Ansible on Ubuntu
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
sudo apt update
sudo apt install software-properties-common
sudo add-apt-repository --yes --update ppa:ansible/ansible
sudo apt install ansible
```
Report problems in the PPA's issue tracker.
